findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed an employee turn off the faucet without using a barrier. CORRECTED: Employee was educated on using the paper towel as a barrier, and rewashed their hands, this time using a paper towel as a barrier when turning off the faucet handle. Ensure that a barrier is used to run off the faucet to avoid recontaminating clean hands after handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: 1ST REPEAT: Observed the inside top of the microwave has an accumulation of food debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned at a frequency necessary to avoid the accumulation of food debris. CORRECTED: PIC was notified and an employee cleaned the microwave, and updated cleaning procedures to include the inside top of the microwave. Ensure that the inside of the microwave to clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. [C]
